LATN 102.description: Classical Latin, Part II. Prerequisite: LATN 101.

LATN 201.description: Completion of the grammatical foundations of classical Latin, Part I. Prerequisite: LATN 102.

LATN 301.description: Completion of the grammatical foundations of classical Latin, Part II; an introduction to the reading of unadapted passages of Latin literature and discussion of their cultural contexts. Credit will be granted for only one of LATN_V 202 or LATN _V 301. Pre-requisites: LATN _V 201. Equivalency: LATN _V 202.

LATN 350.description: Readings in Latin. Prerequisite: One of LATN _V 301, LATN _V 202, LATN _V 200.

LATN 403.course_name: Studies in Latin Prose and Verse
LATN 403.description: Thematic studies using both Latin prose and Latin verse. A maximum of 12 credits can be granted for either one of or any combination of LATN_V 403, LATN_V 503. Prerequisite: One of LATN_V 350, LATN_V 351. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

LATN 503.course_name: Studies in Latin Prose and Verse
LATN 503.description: Advanced thematic studies using both Latin prose and Latin verse. A maximum of 12 credits can be granted for either one of or any combination of LATN_V 403, LATN_V 503. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.
